column12: based on Fallout's Cannon Materials Sheet
All engines were crafted with the same quality material to keep the results consistent.
The best performing material of each attribute in each slot was then identified and all other materials in that attribute put into relation with it.
Example: Tungsten performed best for power in Combustion Internals with a resulting engine with 45 power, in comparison steel created an engine with 32 power.
Substracting the base power of the engine (24) that leaves tungsten with 21 added power and steel with 8.
Tungsten's 21 added power being 100% makes steel's added power in relation 38.1% (rounded).
Base stats are substracted to increase the scalability of the results with engines other than the one used in testing.
